scope: Repair only the independent findings in the three selected files; preserve all frozen P0 capabilities, runtime argv, filenames and all unselected bytes. Do not implement P1/P2 or weaken tests. This is authorized necessary app repair, not template mutation.

findings.problem: Raw URL CR/LF survive validation and can be placed into Location by /go, allowing response-header injection.
findings.required_fix: Reject raw control characters before parsing/normalizing/saving; guard redirect response boundary too; do not silently strip dangerous raw input and accept it.

findings.problem: ThreadingHTTPServer requests share one check_same_thread=False SQLite connection without transaction locking; another request rollback can discard an acknowledged concurrent write.
findings.required_fix: Use per-request isolated connections or serialize complete storage operations/transactions, including precondition reads, commits/rollbacks and shared reads. Preserve category uniqueness and correct error behavior.

evidence_status: Static findings; runtime reproduction kept separately when available.
